root_idea.summary: The root centers on the extinguishing or loss of vitality of something.
root_idea.development: This orientation extends from a fire going out to barren earth, dried vegetation, death, silence, and worn-out matter. The lexical record also preserves divergent Form IV uses involving remaining still and hastening.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized masculine active-participle citation form هَامِدٌ; the Quranic occurrence is its feminine form هَامِدَةً.

senses.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of the earth or land; the Quranic occurrence is the feminine form هَامِدَةً.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a fire, to become completely extinguished, with no fire remaining; to lose its heat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a fire that has gone out entirely, as opposed to one whose flame alone has ceased.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die, become extinct, or perish; also, to nearly perish from hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to living beings or to one in extreme hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a garment or piece of cloth, to become disintegrated and worn out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes deterioration caused by being long folded, so that the material falls to pieces when touched.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the wind, to become still.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to become lifeless and barren, without herbage, wood, or rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the condition of land after its vegetation and vitality have disappeared.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the trees of a land, to become worn out, wasted, and perish.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing the deterioration or destruction of trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of voices, to become silent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use for the cessation of voices.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To still or quiet something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV causative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To kill or destroy a person or persons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV transitive use applied to human beings in the cited lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put an end to an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an affair or matter as the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of drought, to render land sterile, leaving only dried and broken herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The drought is the agent causing the land's sterility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain, stay, or dwell in a place; to be still and not move.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing continued residence or immobility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep silent in an unpleasant situation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended use concerning silence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hasten or move quickly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported divergent Form IV use; it is also attested of a dog running.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fall to eating food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the conventional expression أَهْمَدُوا فِي الطَّعَامِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of apoplexy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A medical or physiological noun; the evidence equates it with سَكْتَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A trance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a trance or suspended state of consciousness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dead sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun for livestock that has died.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Livestock or other property recorded in government accounts as due from a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical administrative or fiscal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dead or extinct; in a state of death or extinction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of something that has lost life or ceased to exist.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Old, worn-out, wasted, or deteriorated, including something blackened and changed for the worse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to cloth or other things that have deteriorated through age or damage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a tree or herbage, blackened, wasted, or dried up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use for deteriorated vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of fruit, black and stinking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjectival use describing spoiled fruit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A date that has just ripened and is thick-skinned and yellow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized noun or adjectival use for a date at this stage of ripeness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of ashes, extinguished or wasted, compacted together, and changed in appearance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the expression رَمَادٌ هَامِدٌ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The trance meaning is already represented under the same headword.

cautions: The Quranic form هَامِدَةً is normalized to the masculine active-participle citation form هَامِدٌ; it is not a finite Form I verb.
